title: Sweet Japanese Rice Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-style rice bowl dish, perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner.
instructions: Rinse the Japanese rice and cook according to package instructions.
In a small saucepan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the roasted vegetables and cook for 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and zesty dressing.
Pour the sauce over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Serve the rice in a bowl and top with the vegetable mixture.
Garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.
